	projectName = system.util.getProjectName()	
	gatewayAddress = self.session.props.gateway.address
	url = '{:}/data/perspective/client/{}/marquee/{:}'.format(gatewayAddress, projectName, marqueeId)
	
	system.perspective.print('url is %s'%url)
	system.perspective.navigate(url=url, newTab=True)
	
	return

marqueeInfo = dict(self.view.custom.marquees.selection.data[0])

	if event.column == 'marqueeName':
		marqueeInfo['marqueeName'] = event.value
		self.view.getChild("root").saveMarquee(marqueeInfo)
	elif event.column == 'marqueeDescription':
		marqueeInfo['marqueeDescription'] = event.value
		self.view.getChild("root").saveMarquee(marqueeInfo)
	elif event.column == 'enabled':
		marqueeInfo['enabled'] = event.value
		self.view.getChild("root").saveMarquee(marqueeInfo)

	return

system.perspective.openPopup('marqueeDisplay', 'kanoa/core/dbp/marquee/createMarqueeDisplay', {}, title='Add a new Marquee display', showCloseIcon=True, draggable=True, resizable=True)
	
	return

selection = self.view.custom.marqueeDisplays.selection.data[0]
	gatewayAddress = self.session.props.gateway.address[:-1]
	url = "{}/data/perspective/client/kanoaMarquee/marquee/display/{}/{}/{}".format(gatewayAddress, selection['siteCode'], selection['location'], selection['screenName'])
	system.perspective.navigate(url=url, newTab=True)
	
	return

selectedMarqueeDisplay = self.view.custom.marqueeDisplays.selection.data
	if len(selectedMarqueeDisplay) == 0: return
	marqueeDisplayInfo = dict(selectedMarqueeDisplay[0])
		
	if event.column == 'enabled': 
		marqueeDisplayInfo['enabled'] = event.value
		self.view.getChild("root").updateMarqueeDisplay(marqueeDisplayInfo)
	
	return

transforms.code:
marqueeOptions = [{'label': marquee['marqueeName'], 'value': marquee['marqueeName']} for marquee in value['marquees']]
	marqueeDisplays = []	
	for marqueeDisplay in value['marqueeDisplays']:
		marqueeDisplay = dict(marqueeDisplay)
		marqueeDisplay['marqueePicker'] = {'options': marqueeOptions, 'value': marqueeDisplay['marqueeName']}
		marqueeDisplay['lastUpdated'] = "%s on %s"%((marqueeDisplay['changedByUser'] or marqueeDisplay['createdByUser']), system.date.format((marqueeDisplay['changedDate'] or marqueeDisplay['createdDate']), 'YY-MM-dd HH:MM'))
		marqueeDisplays.append(marqueeDisplay)
	
	return marqueeDisplays

	marqueeDisplayInfo['marqueeId'] = marqueeId
	self.updateMarqueeDisplay(marqueeDisplayInfo)
	
	return

	selectedMarqueeDisplay = self.view.custom.marqueeDisplays.selection.data
	if len(selectedMarqueeDisplay) == 0:

		return

customMethods.script:
system.perspective.print("deleteMarquee() called")

	userId = self.view.custom.security.userId
	marqueeInfo = self.view.custom.marquees.selection.data
	
	if len(marqueeInfo) == 0 or marqueeInfo[0]['marqueeId'] is None:
		system.perspective.sendMessage('showFailerToast', 'No marquee selected')
		return
			
	retVal, msg = system.kanoa.dashboard.deleteMarquee(marqueeInfo[0]['marqueeId'], userId)

	self.view.refreshBinding("custom.marquees.data")
	
	if msg:	system.perspective.sendMessage('showFailerToast', msg)
	else: system.perspective.sendMessage('showSuccessfulToast', 'Marquee has been deleted')
	
	self.sendMarqueeDisplayUpdate(None)	
	
	return

customMethods.script:
system.perspective.print("updateMarqueeDisplay() called with %s"%marqueeDisplayInfo)

	userId = self.view.custom.security.userId
	retVal, msg = system.kanoa.dashboard.updateMarqueeDisplay(marqueeDisplayInfo, userId)
	if msg:	system.perspective.sendMessage('showFailerToast', msg)
	else: system.perspective.sendMessage('showSuccessfulToast', 'MarqueeDisplay has been saved')
	
	self.view.custom.marqueeDisplays.selection.col = None
	self.view.custom.marqueeDisplays.selection.row = None

	self.view.custom.marqueeDisplays.data = []
	import time
	time.sleep(0.1)
	self.view.refreshBinding("custom.marqueeDisplays.data")
	
	self.sendMarqueeDisplayUpdate(marqueeDisplayInfo['marqueeDisplayId'])
	
	return
